title: Cargo and Freight Agents
description: Expedite and route movement of incoming and outgoing cargo and freight shipments in airline, train, and trucking terminals and shipping docks. Take orders from customers and arrange pickup of freight and cargo for delivery to loading platform. Prepare and examine bills of lading to determine shipping charges and tariffs.

tasks.text: Negotiate and arrange transport of goods with shipping or freight companies.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Operational coordination requires live human orchestration

dwas.name: Negotiate financial arrangements.
dwas.gwa_name: Resolving Conflicts and Negotiating with Others

tasks.text: Determine method of shipment and prepare bills of lading, invoices, and other shipping documents.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Routing analysis from shipping data; human approves

dwas.name: Analyze shipping information to make routing decisions.

tasks.text: Track delivery progress of shipments.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Tracking via systems is digital; physical reconciliation needs humans

tasks.text: Advise clients on transportation and payment methods.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Suggests methods; physical constraints need human check

dwas.name: Recommend packing or shipping methods.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Estimate freight or postal rates and record shipment costs and weights.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Shipping cost calculation from rates and weights

tasks.text: Keep records of all goods shipped, received, and stored.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Record shipping information into structured fields

tasks.text: Notify consignees, passengers, or customers of freight or baggage arrival and arrange for delivery.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Routine customer notifications largely automatable

dwas.name: Provide notifications to customers or patrons.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with People Outside the Organization

tasks.text: Retrieve stored items and trace lost shipments as necessary.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Tracking via systems is digital; physical reconciliation needs humans

tasks.text: Enter shipping information into a computer by hand or by a hand-held scanner that reads bar codes on goods.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Data entry into systems automatable

dwas.name: Enter information into databases or software programs.

tasks.text: Prepare manifests showing numbers of airplane passengers and baggage, mail, and freight weights, transmitting data to destinations.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Maintain operational records in structured systems

tasks.text: Arrange insurance coverage for goods.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Coverage arranged via systems; judgment and liability human

tasks.text: Install straps, braces, and padding to loads to prevent shifting or damage during shipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual packing for shipping

tasks.text: Check import or export documentation to determine cargo contents and use tariff coding system to classify goods according to fee or tariff group.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Cross-checks shipping docs against records and rules

dwas.name: Verify shipping documentation.
dwas.gwa_name: Evaluating Information to Determine Compliance with Standards

tasks.text: Coordinate and supervise activities of workers engaged in packing and shipping merchandise.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Supervising clerical staff is relational management work

tasks.text: Contact vendors or claims adjustment departments to resolve shipment problems or contact service depots to arrange for repairs.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI drafts shipping coordination; external negotiation human

dwas.name: Coordinate shipping activities with external parties.

tasks.text: Inspect and count items received and check them against invoices or other documents, recording shortages and rejecting damaged goods.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — AI can cross-check orders; physical verification human

dwas.name: Inspect items for damage or defects.
Inspect shipments to ensure correct order fulfillment.

tasks.text: Route received goods to first available flight or to appropriate storage areas or departments, using forklifts, hand trucks, or other equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on vehicle and equipment operation

dwas.name: Operate vehicles or material-moving equipment.
dwas.gwa_name: Operating Vehicles, Mechanized Devices, or Equipment

tasks.text: Direct delivery trucks to shipping doors or designated marshaling areas and help load and unload goods safely.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical loading of materials or equipment

tasks.text: Assemble containers and crates used to transport items, such as machines or vehicles.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Wood assembly requires hands-on fitting and fastening

tasks.text: Maintain a supply of packing materials.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Materials inventory records and forecasting automatable

dwas.name: Maintain inventories of materials, equipment, or products.

tasks.text: Direct or participate in cargo loading to ensure completeness of load and even distribution of weight.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Managing clerical staff is supervisory accountability

tasks.text: Pack goods for shipping, using tools such as staplers, strapping machines, and hammers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual packing for shipping

tasks.text: Attach address labels, identification codes, and shipping instructions to containers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Attaching tags to containers is physical

dwas.name: Attach identification information to products, items or containers.

tasks.text: Open cargo containers and unwrap contents, using steel cutters, crowbars, or other hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical loading of materials or equipment
